name: Rhapsody's Kalimdor Kocktail
summary: Rhapsody Shindigger, found in the Hinterlands, will talk about what happened down in the swamp only if given something stiff to drink. A Kalimdor Kocktail needs Roc gizzards from Tanaris and Groddoc and Ironfur livers from Feralas.

sections.title: A Stiff Drink
sections.body: Rhapsody greets Brohann's messenger with a hiccup. The two of them had quite an adventure, and the tale of what happened down in the swamp, which was not a pretty scene, will only come out with something stiff to drink. Rhapsody has a recipe in mind, the Kalimdor Kocktail, and promises to tell everything once it is brewed.

sections.title: Ingredients from Kalimdor
sections.body: The kocktail needs three Roc gizzards from Tanaris, three Groddoc livers from Feralas and three Ironfur livers, also from Feralas. Even Rhapsody's finest malt is not strong enough to face the memory of that fateful flight over the swamp.

faq.q: What does Rhapsody want for the Kalimdor Kocktail?
faq.answer: Three Roc gizzards, three Groddoc livers and three Ironfur livers. Rhapsody wants a stiff drink before talking about what happened in the swamp.

faq.q: Where do the ingredients come from?
faq.answer: The Roc gizzards come from Tanaris. The Groddoc and Ironfur livers come from Feralas.

faq.q: Who sent you to Rhapsody Shindigger?
faq.answer: Brohann, whom Rhapsody calls a crazy fool, sent you. Before that Gryphon Master Talonaxe told you where Rhapsody could be found.
